neighbours.label: narrowing focus from a broader region, group, or subject to a standout member or subset using 'in particular', 'particularly', 'especially', or superlative framing
fire: Coastal municipalities across Scandinavia have upgraded ferry docks for electric vessels. Norway, and in particular Bergen, has commissioned six zero-emission commuter boats.
Public health agencies across the Mediterranean have monitored urban heat islands since 2010. Greece, and in particular Athens, has planted thousands of shade trees along major avenues.
Agricultural cooperatives in East Africa have expanded cold-storage warehouses to reduce spoilage. Kenya, and in particular the Rift Valley, has doubled refrigerated capacity for smallholder growers.
Municipal transit boards in western Canada face growing pressure to cut winter rail delays. Alberta, and in particular Calgary, has retrofitted its light-rail switches with automated heaters.
The ministry coordinates housing, transport, and environmental policy, in particular the coastal flood-barrier program managed by regional engineers.
Art historians have long admired seventeenth-century Dutch landscape painting, particularly those of the Haarlem school during the 1630s.
Several European airlines have retired aging short-haul jets to lower fuel burn. Germany, and in particular Frankfurt, has seen a sharp shift toward quieter twin-engine fleets.
The national archive preserves thousands of early radio broadcasts, and in particular the wartime news bulletins recorded in London.
quiet: Coastal municipalities across Scandinavia have upgraded ferry docks for electric vessels. Norway has commissioned six zero-emission commuter boats for regional routes.
Public health agencies across the Mediterranean have monitored urban heat islands since 2010. Greece has planted thousands of shade trees along major avenues.
Agricultural cooperatives in East Africa have expanded cold-storage warehouses to reduce spoilage. Kenya has doubled refrigerated capacity for smallholder growers over five years.
Municipal transit boards in western Canada face growing pressure to cut winter rail delays. Alberta has retrofitted its light-rail switches with automated heaters.
The ministry coordinates housing, transport, and environmental policy alongside the coastal flood-barrier program managed by regional engineers.
Art historians have long admired seventeenth-century Dutch landscape painting produced by workshops across the northern provinces during the 1630s.
Several European airlines have retired aging short-haul jets to lower fuel burn. Germany has seen a sharp shift toward quieter twin-engine fleets.
The national archive preserves thousands of early radio broadcasts along with printed transcripts from the wartime newsroom in London.
